title: Mini pasta with lentil tomato sauce
summary: Tiny pasta in a smooth, salt-free tomato and lentil sauce that the whole family can eat.
yield: About 4 baby portions (and sauce to spare)
texture: Small, soft-cooked pasta shapes coated in a smooth sauce. Cook the pasta a few minutes past al dente so it squashes easily.
ingredients: 1/2 cup small pasta shapes (like orzo, stelline or small shells)
steps: Warm the oil in a saucepan and cook the grated onion for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and water. Simmer, stirring now and then, for 18 to 20 minutes until the lentils are soft. Blend until smooth.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in unsalted water for 2 to 3 minutes longer than the package says. Drain.
Stir 2 to 3 tablespoons of sauce into a small portion of pasta. Cool before serving.
choking: Use small shapes and cook them extra soft.
Grate the onion so there are no firm pieces in the sauce.

allergens.name: Wheat
allergens.note: Most pasta is made from wheat. Introduce wheat in a simple form (like soft toast or plain pasta) first if it's new.

storage: Sauce keeps 3 days in the fridge or 2 months frozen. Cook pasta fresh, or store cooked pasta in the fridge for 2 days.
tips: Season the grown-ups' portion after you've taken baby's out.
Use chickpea or lentil pasta for extra protein (check for allergens).
